prose.description: The Reavers make their home in Stobe's Garden, and their leader Valamon rules from Ark near its center. Crab Raiders hold a village on a plateau, and Reavers, Crab Raiders, and Skeleton Bandits often skirmish across the land. The remains of Stobe, whom the Skeleton Bandits revere as a god, lie here. Land bats, black gorillos, Black Dragon Ninjas, and bounty hunters roam, and an old watchtower teems with blood spiders.
